result.title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
result.comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Preprint. Not peer reviewed
result.summary: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 Daytona 沙箱全量快照上实现 Go-Explore 式搜索，考察 coding agent 失败后从中间环境状态恢复并分支能否提高求解率，发现收益主要来自仓库之外的运行时状态（数据库、服务等）。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是外部沙箱环境状态而非模型内部 latent 表征，但「保留中间状态、从中恢复并分支搜索」的思路可能与 LVR 中推理状态的复用、轨迹分支与停止决策存在概念类比，可供核查其是否可迁移到 latent 推理状态的保留与搜索评价。
